description: Use this to save or restore a named snapshot of one inbox. Requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (omit when this key is limited to one inbox), action (create, list, diff, restore, or delete), name when action is create, snapshot_id when action is diff, restore, or delete. create returns the snapshot. list returns snapshots newest first. diff returns messages added, label or read changes, and drafts created after the snapshot. restore puts labels and read state back and deletes drafts created after the snapshot. It does not delete messages and it does not unsend mail. The result says unsend false. At most 50 snapshots per inbox. COOPER_INBOX_SNAPSHOTS=off returns HTTP 503 snapshots_disabled. The default is on. Same as /api/v1/inboxes/{id}/snapshots.

action.description: create, list, diff, restore, or delete.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id, username, or email. Omit it when this key is limited to one inbox.

name.description: Snapshot name, 1 to 80 characters. Required for create.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot id (snp_…). Required for diff, restore, and delete.

name: cooper_inbox_snapshot

outputSchema.description: A named inbox snapshot, a list of them, a diff, or a restore result.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the snapshot was taken.

drafts_discarded.description: How many drafts created after the snapshot were deleted, on restore.

id.description: Snapshot id (snp_…), when one snapshot is returned.

messages_added.description: Messages stored after the snapshot. They are not deleted on restore.

note.description: States that sent mail is not unsent.

unsend.description: Always false. Restore does not unsend mail.

title: Inbox snapshot
